How To Win Friend And Influence People Explained in 15 minutes | SeeKen

🎯 How to Win People Instantly | Book Summary of Dale Carnegie’s Timeless Classic
Want to become more likeable, influential, and persuasive in both your personal and professional life? In this video, we break down the timeless wisdom from Dale Carnegie's How to Win Friends and Influence People — one of the most powerful self-help books ever written.

📘 What You'll Learn:
✅ How to make a great first impression
✅ The #1 mistake people make in conversations
✅ How to influence others without being manipulative
✅ Secrets to becoming a better listener
✅ How to turn critics into allies

Whether you're looking to grow your network, improve communication, or become a better leader, this summary has life-changing insights for you.
